en.autoRefresh: The token refreshes automatically while the harness runs.
en.intro: Sign in with ChatGPT to use OpenAI Codex in DSH.
en.loggedIn: Logged in with your ChatGPT account.
en.proxyHint: New requests use the selected route immediately. Active requests keep their connection. System mode uses SSE; PAC is not supported.
en.proxySaveFailed: Could not apply the proxy. Check the manual system proxy and configuration permissions. The previous mode is unchanged.
en.proxyUnavailable: No supported Windows manual HTTPS proxy found. PAC and SOCKS are not supported. Configure a manual proxy or follow DSH.
en.readOnly: The settings document is read-only in this deployment.
en.resetConfirmHint: This may consume one account-wide reset card to reset eligible Codex usage limits. It cannot be undone. Other sessions using this account are affected. The selected card will be used; the server determines which limits reset.
en.resetDetailsPartial: Some cards have no displayable expiry details.
en.resetLegacyPending: An earlier reset has an unresolved record. Check its result in the original version before starting another reset.
en.resetResult_account_changed: Account changed. Return to the original account to resolve the pending reset.
en.resetResult_already_redeemed: This request was already redeemed; no new reset was requested.
en.resetResult_no_credit: The selected reset card is no longer available. Refresh before choosing another card.
en.resetResult_nothing_to_reset: There are no eligible limits to reset. No card was consumed.
en.resetResult_pending: Another reset is pending. Return to its original window to check the result.
en.resetResult_reset: Reset applied. Usage and cards have been refreshed where available.
en.resetResult_unavailable: Could not check available cards. No reset was sent.
en.resetResult_unknown: Result uncertain. Check usage and cards; retry only the same reset. Do not start another reset in a different window.
en.resetRetryHint: The previous result is uncertain. This retries the same request ID, not a new reset. Check current usage and card count before continuing.
